evidence.excerpt: The current restaurant-controlled page identifies Circa at The Boro at 1675 Silver Hill Drive, Tysons, VA 22102 and exposes location-specific lunch, dinner, brunch, dessert, happy-hour, zero-proof, and nonalcoholic-beer menus.

The linked restaurant-issued BORO LUNCH 3.25.26 PDF enumerates the complete lunch menu with descriptions and dietary markers. It states that CIRCA is not a gluten-free environment and asks guests to notify servers of allergies or dietary restrictions.
The linked restaurant-issued BORO DINNER 3.25.26 PDF enumerates the complete dinner menu with descriptions and dietary markers, plus the same gluten-environment and allergy-notification statements.

The linked restaurant-issued BORO BRUNCH 3.25.26 PDF enumerates its brunch products and dietary markers. The live HTML brunch surface additionally displays Four Cheese Spinach and Fried Chicken Sandwich while the PDF displays DC Hot Chicken Sandwich.

The exact restaurant-linked storefront identifies Circa at The Boro at 1675 Silver Hill Dr and exposes 39 consolidated current takeout products across small plates, salads, sandwiches, entrees, flatbreads, desserts, and sides. It provides item descriptions but no comprehensive allergen matrix.
The restaurant-issued The Boro Spring 2026 beverage PDF lists four zero-proof cocktails and two nonalcoholic beers; alcoholic products were excluded from the POC boundary.
The restaurant-controlled ordering hub separately links The Boro to ChowNow location 56385, distinct from the other CIRCA locations.
